blocks.text: Mastering Apple Mail for translators on Mac

As a translator, your inbox is a project management hub. You need to keep track of source texts, glossaries, and delivery deadlines. Apple Mail is built into macOS, making it a reliable choice for your daily communication. It integrates with your contacts and calendar, which helps when tracking project timelines.

Speed is vital when you are juggling multiple clients. Use these shortcuts to move through your email without touching the mouse. Press ⌘ + N to start a new message. Use ⌘ + R to reply to a client. Use ⇧ + ⌘ + D to send your finished translation. If you need to archive a project email, press ⌃ + ⌘ + A.

items: ⌘ + 1 to 9: Jump to specific mailboxes in your sidebar.
⇧ + ⌘ + U: Toggle between read and unread status.
⌘ + F: Open the search bar to find specific project files.
⌘ + ⇧ + F: Forward a message to a colleague or project manager.

blocks.text: Organizing your inbox with Smart Mailboxes

Keeping your inbox clean is difficult when you receive dozens of emails daily. Smart Mailboxes allow you to group emails automatically based on criteria like sender or subject line. Go to Mailbox > New Smart Mailbox to start. You can set rules to catch emails containing specific keywords like invoice, quote, or project name. This ensures you never miss a deadline or a payment request.
Handling large files with Mail Drop

Translation files, especially those with heavy graphics or CAT tool packages, often exceed standard attachment limits. Apple Mail includes Mail Drop for this purpose. When you attach a file larger than 20 MB, Mail automatically uploads it to iCloud. It sends a link to your client instead of the file itself. This keeps your outgoing mail size small and prevents bounce-back errors. The link remains valid for 30 days, which is plenty of time for a client to download your work.

A professional signature builds trust with agencies and direct clients. Go to Mail > Settings > Signatures to create yours. Include your full name, language pairs, and a link to your professional website or ProZ profile. You can drag your signature into the All Signatures folder to make it the default for all accounts.
If you use multiple email accounts, create a unique signature for each one. This prevents you from sending a personal signature to a corporate client.

blocks.text: Sometimes messages get stuck in the Outbox. This is often due to a network interruption or a server sync error. Check your connection in the Activity window by pressing ⌘ + 0. If a mailbox seems out of sync, select it in the sidebar and go to Mailbox > Rebuild. This forces the app to re-index your messages and often fixes search issues.

faq.question: Can I use Apple Mail with my CAT tools?
faq.answer: Apple Mail does not integrate directly with CAT tools, but you can export emails as PDFs or drag them into your project folders for reference.

faq.question: How do I search for emails from a specific client?
faq.answer: Type the client name in the search bar. Apple Mail will suggest contacts. Select the contact to filter results by that sender.

faq.question: Why are my emails not syncing?
faq.answer: Check your internet connection and ensure your account settings are correct in System Settings > Internet Accounts.
